sourcePrompt: Create a Todo List app with tasks, statuses, priorities, and due dates. Users should manage tasks through a list and form page and track task lifecycle.

businessOutcome.value: Track task execution with clear lifecycle visibility

actorsAndRoles.value: Business users create and update tasks

domainModel.value: UsrTodoTask with status and priority lookups

businessRules.value: Title required, default status New, due date cannot be in past for new tasks

uxExpectations.value: List and form pages for task management

edgeCases.value: Invalid due date and empty title should be blocked

acceptanceCriteria.value: Users can create/update tasks and track lifecycle in list/form views
